title: Unbiased Sliced Wasserstein Kernels for High-Quality Audio Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating caption quality, lexical diversity, and text-to-audio retrieval accuracy using automated metrics (e.g., SPICE, METEOR, CIDEr) and human evaluation to quantify the mitigation of training-inference mismatch (text degeneration) in audio captioning models.
Mathematically proving that the proposed Unbiased Sliced Wasserstein RBF (USW-RBF) kernel provides an unbiased estimate of the true Sliced Wasserstein kernel.
